description: This file defines the class `actionSendEmail` responsible for sending emails within the SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods for loading email templates, parsing templates with data, retrieving email addresses from different sources, and sending emails with attachments. It extends the base class `actionBase` and interacts with various SuiteCRM modules such as EmailTemplates, Notes, Users, and Emails.

classes.name: actionSendEmail
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the process of sending emails, including template parsing, retrieving recipient addresses, and dispatching emails with attachments within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance of the class, calling the parent constructor and clearing email status counters.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript files associated with this action.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates the HTML for editing or configuring the email sending action, including template selection and email options.

methods.name: getEmailsFromParams
methods.description: Extracts email addresses from the provided parameters and related bean, supporting various target types like direct email, user, related field, or record email.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the email sending process by retrieving the email template, parsing it, and sending individual or bulk emails, returning success status.

methods.name: clearLastEmailsStatus
methods.description: Resets counters for successfully sent emails and failed attempts.

methods.name: getLastEmailsFailed
methods.description: Returns the count of emails that failed to send during the last run.

methods.name: getLastEmailsSuccess
methods.description: Returns the count of successfully sent emails during the last run.

methods.name: parse_template
methods.description: Parses email templates by replacing placeholders with actual data from the related bean, preparing the email subjects and bodies for dispatch.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves attachments linked to the email template, typically Notes associated with the template.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Composes and sends an email using SugarPHPMailer, handling recipients, subject, body, attachments, and logging the email in the system.
